title: Touhou Ensougetsu ~ Blue Moon Rhapsody - Crystal Shine Road
description:
The Extra Stage theme from a Touhou-style music album by Chama.

It's a very repetitive song, with slight variations on one phrase that repeats over and over. Despite that, it feels very energetic.

Special thanks to icrawfish for helping me transcribe the piano chords I couldn't make out in the one unique section.
